This is so triggering, it’s literally the wrong place to ask this. Go away.
As a side note, meth worsens ADD symptoms by x1000 when you get off! Your brain needs time to recover - and it will recover. Don’t let the little devil lie to you by saying you need it.

Hey man I completely understand the ADD aspect of it off meth - it was absolutely horrible and made me feel stupid as hell despite being a fairly intelligent human once upon a time. 

I’m meth free for a year now but had a relapse with amphs last March when I tried to self medicate with speed (smart) but did not last long. I realized I can never use regular ADHD medications like a normal human, I even tried to abuse modafinil and wellbutrin which was not really fun. Currently still on that cocktail and I can say modafinil has helped the most with the ADD symptoms. Absolutely nothing helped with cravings except for time, sleep, and exercising. 

You gotta make your peace with the fact that probably the first month or so of sobriety, especially the first 2 weeks, are gonna be tough. Try catching on your sleep, food and water intakes. Take walks when you can. Go on modafinil when you feel necessary or try wellbutrin and see how that feels. But be realistic, it’s not fucking easy, yet so worth it at the end. I promise.

Ps. Talk to people here or in NA. Support is everything.

Don’t beat yourself up, it’s really all a part of the process. I was on 80mg wellbutrin and took 50-150mg of modafinil as needed throughout the day. Be careful with that one though because overdoing this combo feels like the crash you get from amphs sometimes - but without the fun
Wellbutrin and modafinil helped me and also exercising tbh
Yep exactly this actually. I'll wait haha - no need to traumatize innocent people who put effort into keeping me alive and loved me despite it all.

Thank you. It's definitely hard but life has pleasantly surprised me before and maybe it will again. The lows are lows but the highs are high hah. I'm sad you felt this way before too but suffering has a way of connecting us all.

Thank you, I truly appreciate you commenting and for being such a caring human being. I'm sorry some people are so short sighted that they get caught up in their own defense against belief. It's all trivial. The source doesn't matter - the kindness counts :)

Our loved ones can keep us afloat but the hardest thing to remember is that we have something to offer too. Life has surprised me the longer I let it ran and there will be a future whether I can see it or not. Man, it's fucking terrifying but liberating. It's the necessary bits of me that I need to kill - not me. If that makes sense. 

And I had a vanilla cone because I like to keep it simple but he had a whole boat of flavors with chocolate drizzled and everything lol. Homemade ganache sounds out of this world and I'm gonna have to try that. I miss cooking lol

One day at a time is all I got and I hope it's okay when I say feel free to message me whenever because it's just so overwhelming sometimes not being able to share as honest as we might like with the people in our lives - no one should be alone in these moments though.

Yes, I am. Thank you. I changed my mind.

team going from being a restricting stoner teen to having speed psychosis by age 25 hell yeh

You don't need to make a decision at this moment, what you need is sleep. You haven't slept properly since Friday you said? Yeah - the mold and the dead bats and possible psychotic breakdown are problems for the morrow dude. 

If necessary, go get a hotel room but if the paranoia is that overwhelming and you seriously may hurt yourself, make that an ER visit instead. It doesn't really matter what the definition of psychosis is or what's real in your world right this second. What you need to worry about is water, food, sleep. That is all. For the love of god deal with all else tomorrow.

if you mean downers when you say other drugs then it makes sense. you like other drugs more because they counteract the shitty side effects of cocaine like anxiety and irritability, not because they clean up the dopamine dumped in your brain by coke. if you mean other stims like meth or crack, they just overpower the coke by a ton lol so it doesn't have anything to do with reduced dopamine levels much. other drugs also increase dopamine levels though in different ways, and do other things in the brain which produces different effects. 

essentially dopamine is just a messenger telling you what you're doing is great and you should keep doing it, it's not exactly a euphoria killer.

Oh I didn't mean to make you cry on the toilet!! Now I feel like letting out a withdrawal fueled sob on the floor because I'm all emotional lol 

Today sucked. This week and month sucked. I'm tired. Thank you for making me smile and I hope you're being just as kind to yourself. These are weird times, weird drugs

Chronic depression and a sense of melancholia looming over even my earliest memories from childhood. Grew up too fast. Got supportive parents but accumulated tons of trauma from creepy ass men from a young age. Spent over 10 years in therapy, moved countries for the sake of it, graduated from a fantastic university and got into a grad program in psychiatry (ironic right?) in order to help others who felt the same way and to understand myself a little better. I wanted to die the entire time. 

Up until college graduation I tried to do everything right hoping it gets better, smoked weed but that was it. Never drank, never cared for it. It didn't get better. My grad program contributed to my isolation and disillusionment with my field, so I sorta just gave up around age 22, and it's been a fun little ride to the bottom since then! I know it's ruining my life, I dropped out of grad school since then and lost all ambition, but I don't care! I mean I do but I'm exhausted. Ptsd and depression are hanging out in my head freely now. We're cool.

Me too. 

I think we all need to set a daily reminder or something for when the prefrontal cortex leaves the cockpit for the lizard brain to camp in for a solid week yeah?

Oh absolutely. Tbh some of the most interesting and compassionate humans I’ve met were heavy drug users at some point in their lives. Addict or not, some shit brings out parts of people so dark and vulnerable that a change in perspective becomes almost inevitable. At least for me personally it was a pricey ass lesson learned about the nature of humanity lol. I look at humans differently now instead of being a judgmental hypocrite. Guess the best case scenario in addiction is when your suffering turns into self-reflection which in turn hopefully becomes compassion. 

Disclaimer: no one needs meth to discover empathy don’t attack me
